hero_kpi_rationale: The equity ratio reflects the significant strengthening of the bank's financial soundness, rising from 17.12% to 24.05%, driven by capital increases via bonus share issuance and aligned with Zambia's central bank new capital rules.

kpis.name: Operating revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from banking activities before deduction of operating costs.
kpis.description: Operating revenue declines in 2025, reflecting the refocusing strategy on CIB and the sale of the Wealth and Retail Banking segment.
kpis.signal: Revenue decline linked to WRB segment exit.

kpis.name: Profit after tax
kpis.explanation: Net profit of the bank after all charges and taxes.
kpis.description: Profit after tax declines from 247 million to 236 million ZMW, impacted by reduced business activity but supported by an impairment release of 108 million.
kpis.signal: Slight profit decline despite impairment release.

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets held by the bank.
kpis.description: Total assets decline due to the gradual exit from the retail segment, in line with the Fit for Growth strategy.
kpis.signal: Asset reduction linked to WRB disengagement.

kpis.name: Return on equity
kpis.explanation: Net profit divided by equity, measuring performance for shareholders.
kpis.description: ROE declines to 18% in 2025 versus 22% in 2024, due to a higher capital base and reduced business activity.

kpis.name: Total capital ratio
kpis.explanation: Regulatory ratio measuring the bank's financial soundness.
kpis.description: Total capital ratio jumps to 24.05%, well above the regulatory minimum of 10% and supported by capital increases via bonus share issuance.

kpis.name: Number of employees
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the bank.
kpis.description: The bank reduces headcount to 270 employees, linked to the sale of the WRB segment.
kpis.signal: Headcount reduction in a transition context.

kpis.name: Number of branches and agencies
kpis.explanation: Total number of physical sales points for CIB (3 agencies) following the sale of the WRB network to FNB Zambia.
kpis.description: Number of agencies drops to 3 (CIB only) from 104 in 2024 (3 CIB plus 93 WRB), due to the sale of the WRB network to FNB Zambia.
kpis.signal: Drastic reduction in physical network following WRB network sale.

kpis.name: Total shareholder return
kpis.explanation: Total shareholder performance, including share price appreciation and dividends.
kpis.description: TSR declines to 18% in 2025 from 22% in 2024, reflecting lower shareholder remuneration or weaker stock market performance.
kpis.signal: Return decline despite relative price stability.

kpis.name: Earnings per share
kpis.explanation: Net profit divided by the number of shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Earnings per share decline from K0.15 to K0.14, reflecting the decrease in net profit in a strategic transition context.
kpis.signal: Slight EPS decline despite bank resilience.

kpis.short: Diversity and inclusion: women in senior roles
kpis.name: Women in senior roles
kpis.explanation: Percentage of women holding management and senior responsibility positions.
kpis.description: Percentage of women in senior roles declines from 40% to 38%, potentially linked to organizational transition and group restructuring.
kpis.signal: Slight decline after several years of progress.

risks.title: Sovereign rating ceiling limiting credit ratings
risks.score_rationale: Major risk explicitly mentioned in Item 1A (CRO Review): sovereign rating ceiling (Zambia at Caa2/CCC+) constrains CIB portfolio credit ratings, preventing upgrades. Intensive language ('constrain', 'delayed'). Stable but persistent trend. Direct impact on portfolio composition (large portion in Stress Assets).

risks.title: Sovereign exposure classified as defaulted impacting renewals
risks.score_rationale: Risk specific to SCBZ mentioned in Item 1A: sovereign exposure classified as defaulted under internal framework, blocking extensions/renewals to public enterprises. Direct language ('defaulted', 'delayed', 'constrain'). Stable trend but major operational impact. High weight for CIB strategy.

risks.title: National load-shedding affecting key sectors
risks.score_rationale: Risk specific to Zambian operating environment mentioned in Item 1A: ongoing nationwide load-shedding impacting agriculture, manufacturing, energy. Explicit language ('nationwide load-shedding', 'tested resilience'). Stable but persistent trend. Direct impact on CIB and WRB portfolio quality.

risks.title: Sovereign debt restructuring delaying growth
risks.score_rationale: Major risk in Item 1A: ongoing sovereign restructuring (process not completed) blocks rating upgrades and balance sheet growth. Intensive language ('pending completion', 'delayed', 'constrain'). Stable trend but critical for 2026 strategy. High weight for entity viability.

risks.title: CIB portfolio concentration in institutional relationships
risks.score_rationale: Risk specific to Item 1A (CRO Review): CIB portfolio concentrated in Nostros, Interbank and Securities (institutional relationships). Neutral language but revealing structure. Stable trend. Moderate concentration (top 20 groups equals 14.7%, top 20 financial institutions less than 1%), but dependence on institutional counterparties.

risks.title: Dependence on Wealth and Retail Banking segment sale
risks.score_rationale: Major strategic risk in Item 1A: WRB sale projected before end of 2026, requiring maintenance of robust organizational structures. Explicit language ('WRB sale projected', 'dedicated to maintaining'). New/up trend (announced in 2025). Critical impact on entity viability and operational continuity.

risks.title: Increased risk-weighted asset intensity from corporate exposures
risks.score_rationale: Risk specific to Item 1A: elevated sovereign risk has increased RWA intensity of corporate exposures, impacting risk-adjusted returns. Direct language ('elevated sovereign risk', 'increased risk-weighted asset intensity'). Stable trend. Moderate impact on profitability but significant for balance sheet growth.

risks.title: Foreign exchange regulation tightening market liquidity
risks.score_rationale: Risk specific to Item 1A: revisions in FX regulation by the central bank have tightened market liquidity and reduced FX spreads. Explicit language ('Revisions in FX regulation', 'tightened market liquidity'). Stable trend. Moderate impact on trading revenue but significant for FX strategy.
